subject: When one equipment decision changes another
preheader: The hoist, commode, room access and trial arrangements may need one joined-up brief.
intro: A hoist, a commode and a doorway can each look straightforward until they need to work as one practical setup.
A change to one item may raise another question about access, transfer space, assistance or the order in which equipment needs to arrive.
body: Supply Ministry can help source and coordinate equipment across categories, with the person's functional requirements and your clinical direction guiding the work.

Three things make a useful starting brief: the functional goal and what is already specified; the space and access constraints; and any trial, delivery or collection that depends on another step happening first. We can help bring those dependencies into the sourcing and quote discussion.

Suitability, compatibility and availability still need to be confirmed for the actual setup. Identifying those open questions early helps keep the discussion focused on what the equipment needs to do together.
actionTitle: More than one item to organise?
actionText: Reply with a short, de-identified outline of the whole equipment question. It is enough to start a practical sourcing and coordination discussion.
